# Evaluation Result

Add this record only after the bound Evaluation Definition is frozen. Record facts as observed; do not add a merge recommendation or select a next action.

## Bound definition and actual identities

Link the frozen definition and record the actual repository, evaluator, model, harness, environment, workload, and tool identities.

## Actual result

List each command or trial with its return code, validity, measurement, elapsed time, and retained evidence reference.

## Valid, failed, interrupted, and unrun trials

Account for every declared trial. Distinguish an invalid environment or evaluator failure from a valid rejection of the project revision.

## Correctness, performance, and cost facts

Record only measured values, units, samples, uncertainty, GPU time, wall time, tokens, and expensive operations that actually occurred.

## Terminal reasons and uncertainty

Explain why the evaluation ended and which unresolved factors limit interpretation.

## Supported claim scope

State the narrowest claim supported by the result and the claims it does not establish.

## Private material

Confirm that no private material was uploaded or used as public proof.
